text:
Select: [assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value]
Source: [activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures]
Join: [activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno]
Filter: [activities.type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075319', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606]
Sort: [molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC]
Limit: 1000
